capabilities: find liked Spotify tracks missing from all playlists
save the results as a dated note with Spotify links
configure output folder and Spotify app credentials
extras: Desktop only; the Obsidian mobile app is not supported. Requires manually creating a Spotify Developer app and setting a redirect URI. The listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Spotify's own app offers no easy way to see which Liked Songs are missing from every playlist, and Obsidian has no way to pull that list into a note.

relations.evidence: finds Liked Songs in your Spotify library that aren't in any of your playlists

requires.name: Spotify Client ID and Client Secret

summary: Spotify integration that finds liked songs not in any playlist and saves them as a dated vault note.
